label: ACCEPT
reason: Every concrete parser (atem, qwen, zaya, xml_function and the rest) carries @ToolParserManager.register_module; the only exempt class, ToolParserManager in abstract_tool_parser.py, defines the decorator (one_off), so the simplest violation decides. It is not TRIVIAL by framework: server.py wraps ToolParserManager.get_tool_parser in try/except, logs a warning or error and falls back to _generic_parse_filtered, so an unregistered parser fails neither at startup nor on request, and ruff/mypy in pyproject.toml do not check this; a required registration decorator that silently degrades when missing is worth flagging.
